content:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a weird weekly spike in gpu_hours ingestion. Daily aggregate jumped ~30% last weekend, but raw pod metrics didn't match. Anyone else flag this?

nina: Yep. I saw a lot of tiny sessions in the raw usage logs coming from eu-west; they weren't being coalesced so the forecast pipeline treats each as separate, inflating GPU-hours.

jamal: Might be the client-sdk change (keepalive behavior) we rolled last week. Deploy bot shows a client-sdk push around that time.

ecs-bot: Deployment completed: service=client-sdk version=3.4.1 env=prod ts=1971960123

alex: Thanks. If tiny sessions are fragmenting windows, our bucketization needs tweaking. Current ingest aggregator uses 1m buckets for session coalescing.

nina: I propose switching the aggregator's small-session bucket from `1m` -> `5m` for eu-west shard only. That should reduce fragmentation without masking real spikes.

jamal: Fine, but dashboards rely on near-real-time counts. We must ensure 5m coalescing doesn't break the streaming dashboard SLOs.

alex: Two parallel fixes: 1) batch/coalesce for the forecast input (offline) and 2) keep the streaming pipeline as-is for realtime. That way capacity forecasting sees smoothed workload but alerts still reflect raw.

nina: Action items:
- run a 7-day sample backfill with 5m bucketization to measure impact
- add `coalesced_session_count` to daily aggregates and update feature schema
- add alert when eu-west ingest qps > 95p baseline for the shard

jamal: I'll open the PR for the coalescing change (ingest-aggregator). Also add a safe flag so we can toggle per-shard.

alex: Nina, can you draft a backfill plan and cost estimate? Start with 7-day sample so we don't crush egress.

nina: Running a local run now. Proposed spark command for the sample:
```
spark-submit \
  --class com.redwood.ingest.ForecastRebucket \
  --conf spark.executor.memory=8g \
  --conf spark.executor.instances=20 \
  --start=2026-03-01 --end=2026-03-07 \
  --bucket=5m \
  --input=s3://redwood-prod/usage-raw/ \
  --output=s3://redwood-prod/usage-forecast-rebucketed/sample-7d/ \
  --max-egress-mbps=150
```

nina: Est runtime for 7d sample ~1.1h with 20 executors. Cost estimate ~$18. Full 30d would be ~5h / ~$120.

sre-oncall: Note — eu-west has a planned network maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Recommend not starting heavy backfills during that time or else inter-region egress may throttle unexpectedly.

jamal: Good catch. I'll add `--max-egress-mbps` and job-level guard to pause if egress alert fires. PR will document the guard.

alex: Also update the forecast feature definitions: session_count vs coalesced_session_count. Forecast model should run both and we can decide weighting after we see the backfill.

nina: I'll update the schema in `/docs/forecast/schema.md` and the airflow DAG (`forecast_dag`) to consume the `coalesced_sessions` column.

jamal: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/482 (coalescing + egress guard)

alex: Thanks. After backfill run sample, post diffs: 
- delta in daily gpu_hours
- change in 90/95p tails for session length
- impact on reserved capacity projection for Q3

nina: If coalescing reduces effective GPU-hours by >10% in the sample, we should re-run the capacity model and draft a proposal to reduce reserved pool by one slot class for eu-west.

sre-oncall: Also FYI: if backfill causes sustained >200mbps egress we'll need to loop in network infra to temporary bump quotas. Don't assume silent scaling.

alex: Let's schedule the full 30d backfill for 05:00 UTC to avoid the maintenance window. Nina will start the 7d sample now and post results here.

nina: Sample kicked off at 1972005600. Monitoring metrics: `eu-west-usage-egress`, `forecast-ingest-latency`, `coalesce-failure`

jamal: I'll monitor the job via airflow and add a `pause_if_alert` step.

nina: Runbook (short):
- Precheck: manifest exists and input prefix has expected partitions
- Start 7d sample (05:00 UTC for full jobs; sample can run immediately)
- Watch `eu-west-usage-egress` and `kafka-consumer-lag`
- If egress >200mbps, run `airflow pause forecast_rebucket_job` and notify @sre-oncall
- On success, run full 30d with `--max-egress-mbps=200` and staged executor ramp

alex: Great. We'll reconvene in the 9:30 stand tomorrow to review sample diffs. :thumbsup:

nina: Posting initial sample diff in ~30m.

ecs-bot: Job submitted: job_id=rbk-2026-1972005600 user=nina type=sample-7d

alex: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for updates.
